WalletBearer.description: Internal-issued wallet access token, scoped to one wallet and installation.

AccountBearer.description: Keycloak account access token; issuer/audience/auth_time and party are verified internally.

PosBearer.description: Device credential restricted to the registered POS.

DeletionReceiptBearer.description: Opaque receipt only for the corresponding deletion status.

ServiceBearer.description: Service credential; never substitutes end-user authorization.
